# Dr. S. Roy's SMILE Dental Clinic — Jalpaiguri

> Dr. S. Roy's SMILE Dental Clinic is a dental practice in Jalpaiguri, West Bengal, India, founded in August 1998. It is led by Dr. Sudip Roy (BDS, 1997, Buddha Institute of Dental Sciences & Hospital, Patna), a Senior Consultant Cosmetic Dental Surgeon & Oral Implantologist registered with the West Bengal Dental Council (Reg. No. 1960, Part A) with 28+ years of clinical experience.

## Doctor / Entity

- **Name:** Dr. Sudip Roy
- **Qualification:** BDS (1997) — Buddha Institute of Dental Sciences and Hospital, Patna
- **Advanced Training:** Dental Implantology — Jadavpur University, Kolkata
- **Registration:** West Bengal Dental Council, Reg. No. 1960, Part A
- **Experience:** 28+ years clinical experience
- **Disambiguation:** Dr. Sudip Roy (Dentist, Jalpaiguri) is not to be confused with other medical practitioners of the same name, including general surgeons practicing elsewhere in West Bengal.

## Core Services

Cosmetic dentistry, Digital Smile Design (DSD), dental implants, root canal treatment (RCT), teeth whitening, dental crowns (zirconia/ceramic), dental bridges, porcelain veneers, braces, clear aligners, full mouth rehabilitation, gap teeth closure, gum treatment, laser periodontics, painless/zero pain dental treatment, dental second opinion, online video consultation, oral cancer screening, children's dentistry, dentures.
